metadata.name: Afreximbank
metadata.provenance: financials built 25-Nov-26 from Afreximbank FY2025 Audited & 9M 2026 IFRS Financial Statements; quotes await [BBG]

financials_multi_year.source: Afreximbank FY2025 Audited IFRS Financial Statements, read 25-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY25 record net income $1.20bn (+19% YoY), shareholders' funds $8.4bn, total approvals $29.72bn.

financials_multi_year.source: Afreximbank 9M 2026 Unaudited IFRS Financial Results, read 25-Nov-26

observations.notes: 9M26 total assets & contingencies $54.1bn (+12% vs YE25), net loans & advances $36.2bn (+8%), shareholders' funds $9.0bn (GCI II + retained earnings), net income $813.5m (+24% YoY).

debt_maturities.source: Jul-26 $1.5bn dual-tranche public Eurobond (XS3437376612 + 2032 tranche; bank also carries private/loan/EUR debt).

verdict.stance: Overweight / Preferred-Creditor-Treated African Trade Bank Growing NI +24% (Baa2 / BBB)
verdict.summary: Afreximbank's 9M26 net income jumped 24% YoY to $813.5m on $54.1bn assets/contingencies and $9.0bn equity, after pricing a landmark $1.5bn dual-tranche Eurobond in July 2026 ($3.8bn orderbook). Sovereign restructuring treatments (Ghana/Zambia/Malawi) remain the primary rating debate vs strong profitability and GCI II capital inflows.

positives: 9M26 net income surged 24% YoY to $813.5m; FY25 NI $1.2bn.
Equity strengthened to $9.0bn (up from $8.4bn YE25) via GCI II paid-in capital and retained earnings.
Successful market re-entry with $1.5bn Jul-26 dual-tranche Eurobond ($3.8bn peak book).
negatives: Sovereign borrower concentration and preferred-creditor-status (PCS) disputes in African restructurings.
High exposure to Nigerian/Ghanaian/Egyptian sovereign & energy trade flows.

background.business_overview: Pan-African multilateral trade-finance institution established by African states and central banks.
background.asset_perimeter: Trade finance, sovereign/quasi-sovereign project loans, export guarantees, and PAPSS payment platform.
background.ownership_governance: 53 African member states, central banks, and institutional shareholders.

recent_drivers: 9M26: NI $813.5m (+24%), assets & contingencies $54.1bn, net loans $36.2bn, equity $9.0bn.
Jul-26: Priced $1.5bn dual-tranche Eurobond ($750m Jan-32 at 6.25%, $750m Jul-36 XS3437376612 at 7.125%).

catalysts.event: FY2026 Audited IFRS Results & Sovereign Restructuring Exposure Update
